entries.765bdf5e10cfed99: The core subsidiary Genky Co., Ltd. operates the drugstore 'Genky'. In addition to pharmaceuticals and cosmetics, it carries a wide range of daily necessities, including food and sundries.

entries.a39d45dbe754d68f: All revenue comes from the drugstore business (a single segment). By prefecture, revenue was ¥79,640 million in Aichi, ¥63,247 million in Gifu, ¥37,740 million in Fukui, ¥29,287 million in Ishikawa and ¥10,722 million in Shiga, concentrated in the Chubu region. By product, food is the largest at ¥156,911 million, far exceeding pharmaceuticals at ¥16,475 million. The company recognizes that competition in openings and prices across the drugstore industry, crossing industry and format boundaries, has intensified, and that industry consolidation through M&A is accelerating.
entries.a799abc0367fe734: It is a single segment covering retail sales of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, miscellaneous goods, food and other products. The core subsidiary Genki Co., Ltd. operates the drugstore “Genky”, offering a wide range of daily necessities under the concept of “a store where you can save on living costs nearby.” As of June 20, 2026, it operates a total of 534 stores in Fukui, Ishikawa, Gifu, Aichi and Shiga prefectures, consisting of 506 standardized 300-tsubo R stores and 28 large-format stores. Revenue by store format was ¥197,228 million for R stores, ¥23,113 million for large-format stores and ¥297 million for others. Genki Shokuhin Co., Ltd. handles food manufacturing, Genki Fudosan Co., Ltd. handles store development and Genki Logistics Co., Ltd. handles logistics, and together they support store operations across the group.
entries.a8ae27e9251aa2b5: It is the holding company of a group that operates the drugstore business.
entries.b4a13b31b597b0c1: Under the concept of 'a store where living costs can be saved nearby,' its policy is to pursue overwhelming low prices; aiming to be 'a store where you can find everything,' it will broaden its range of daily necessities beyond pharmaceuticals and cosmetics and strengthen its handling of fresh food such as vegetables and meat; and to increase its regional share, it will pursue dominant area development and low-cost operations that make use of its own logistics bases. As issues to address, it cites building dominant areas through openings of the fully standardized 300-tsubo R store, securing and developing personnel, raising the technical and management level of store operations, and sound profit management and deepening low-cost management. Its management philosophy reads: 'We will create a chain store trusted by the nation and people of Japan with enthusiasm, and contribute to improving the lives of people in the community.'
